metadata.description: Butter chicken, a dish synonymous with the vibrant and robust spirit of Delhi, embodies the essence of the city's rich culinary heritage. Tender roasted chicken bathed in a rich, smooth, buttery gravy has captured the hearts and palates of both the young and old. But have you ever wondered about its origin? Interestingly, there are various captivating stories behind its creation. In today's episode, we'll explore these intriguing tales while taking you on a delightful culinary journey. We also visited  three legendary butter chicken spots - namely Moti Mahal, Havemore and Kwality restaurant- that have been serving their version of this signature dish. Get ready for a mouthwatering adventure as we delve into the history and flavors of these beloved dishes.
